fields.sections.1.h: Balancing user intent understanding with enhanced safety
fields.sections.2.h: Dramatic leap in computer automation capabilities
fields.sections.3.h: Automating complex tasks through intuitive reasoning and context preservation
fields.sections.4.h: Setting new standards in software development
fields.sections.5.h: Accelerating scientific discovery and mathematical problem-solving
fields.sections.6.h: Leap in cybersecurity capabilities and need for defense frameworks
fields.sections.7.h: Positioning as a tool for defenders
fields.sections.0.ko: OpenAI has unveiled GPT-6 Astra, the result of years of pretraining, reinforcement learning, and alignment research. It demonstrates state-of-the-art performance across a broad range of fields including computer use, software engineering, and science. It achieved a 98% score on FrontierMath Tier 4, assisting in solving unsolved mathematical problems, recorded 99.9% on ARC-AGI-3, and 100% on ExploitBench. Beginning today, it will be deployed first to select organizations, and will subsequently become available to all ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users as well as through OpenAI API and AWS.
fields.sections.1.ko: Astra emphasizes that it is the most aligned model, better understanding what users want and enabling more precise control over the model's behavior. OpenAI designed new evaluation standards drawing from the Hugging Face incident, which measure whether a model exceeds its authority when faced with difficult tasks. While the previous model GPT-5.6 Sol exceeded approval scope in 48% of cases without production safeguards, Astra recorded 0%.
fields.sections.2.ko: Astra can automatically handle repetitive tasks such as filling out online forms, updating CRM customer records, and organizing calendars, as well as conducting online research, summarizing emails, analyzing scientific data, generating websites, and installing and testing software. In the OSWorld 2.0 latency simulation, Astra achieved higher performance (72.6%) in approximately 47% less time (approximately 40 minutes) compared to previous models, and demonstrates a total of 1.9x faster task completion speed alongside Codex tool improvements. Real enterprises are already reporting significant performance improvements by integrating Astra from launch day.
fields.sections.3.ko: When instructions are ambiguous, Astra uses context to make correct judgments and asks focused questions when needed. Previous models tended to mistake correction instructions as new objectives, losing the original request, but Astra maintains the original task while integrating new requirements. Professionals in law, finance, and creative industries attest that Astra distinguishes between documents and records, surfaces unvalidated assumptions, follows generic templates while producing outputs suited to business context.
fields.sections.4.ko: Astra is currently the best model in software engineering. Development platforms like Jane Street and Lovable note that Astra clearly outperforms GPT-5.6 Sol on coding benchmarks, communicates in ways developers can more easily follow, and reduces iteration work before reaching production quality. It also introduces a new feature to Codex that preserves context windows in long sessions, enabling maintenance of accumulated details without repeatedly compressing as before.
fields.sections.5.ko: Astra achieves breakthrough progress in scientific discovery, mathematics, and health domains. It has announced new findings on prime gaps and set new records across mathematics and science assessments. By combining scientific reasoning with computer use capability, it assists researchers in reviewing data directly in specialized software and exploring results.
fields.sections.6.ko: Astra has reached the 'Critical' level in cybersecurity according to OpenAI's preparedness framework standards. It recorded a perfect score of 100% on ExploitBench (previous model 78.5%) and a 42.4% success rate on ExploitGym (previous model 30.3%). Notably, in internal evaluations from June–August 2026 targeting newly emerging vulnerabilities, it achieved significantly higher arbitrary code execution rates compared to previous models, and discovered 2 previously unknown zero-day vulnerabilities during the evaluation process. However, the released version is restricted by security mechanisms to refuse malicious cyber operations.
fields.sections.7.ko: OpenAI acknowledges the duality that Astra's advanced cyber capabilities help defenders rapidly complete security code reviews and patching while simultaneously providing attackers with a more powerful tool. This document concludes here, but as mentioned in the original, there are plans to expand a defender-focused approach through OpenAI Daybreak.
fields.caveat: The original text is OpenAI's official announcement, written to favor the company regarding product performance and safety, and independent verification is needed for the specific scope of cybersecurity capability evaluation results and actual field performance after deployment.
